title: CyanoSphere: code and derived data for Scarampi et al., convergent metabolic functions in cyanobacterial communities
description: Code and derived data tables that regenerate every number, table and figure panel of Convergent metabolic functions in cyanobacterial communities emerge from imposed and community-derived niches (Scarampi, Duxbury, Coates, Eren, Soyer), with the HPC jobs that produced the tables from reads and a step-by-step workflow (WORKFLOW.md). Raw reads and MAGs: NCBI BioProject PRJNA1432497.
